answer.rationale: Renewal currently best protects delivery continuity with the line at 94% committed volume, no buffer, and only 14 days remaining. The low-cost vendor could support the spend target, but memory_c2 establishes cost, onboarding, and invoicing performance—not delivery reliability under near-full load. Verify it because evidence of sustained delivery performance could change the decision; absent that evidence, a primary-vendor switch would increase delivery risk. Renewal does not resolve the 18% savings mandate, so that tradeoff remains explicit.
